top_signals.title: Kansas City Fed's Schmid says inflation 'stubborn' and 'sticky,' policy rate not restrictive
top_signals.summary: The policymaker stopped just short of calling for an interest rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Climb as Nvidia’s Outlook Lifts Tech Sector
top_signals.summary: A blockbuster outlook from chip darling Nvidia Corp. is providing a boost to tech stocks and lifting key equity indexes Thursday morning, adding to investor optimism about the AI cycle.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: DOJ firearms agency says hackers breached system containing investigation targets
top_signals.summary: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives confirmed it experienced a cyberattack on a system containing investigation information, as a prolific ransomware gang claimed to have carried out the breach.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
